name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
description: National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) - Voluntary framework for managing risks in the design, development, use, and evaluation of AI systems

policies.requirement_description: Policies, processes, procedures, and practices across the organization related to the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risk are in place, transparent, and implemented effectively.
Context is established and understood, and AI risks related to the AI system are identified and documented.
AI risks are measured quantitatively or qualitatively, and the results are documented, including uncertainty and error rates.
AI risks are prioritized and acted upon. Responses are developed, implemented, and monitored to maximize benefits and minimize negative impacts.
